name: Thanks for dinner!
source:
In NN town, people began to disappear... No one knows where they are missing. The story gives you the opportunity to influence the outcome of the events. Will you be able to prevent people from going missing or will you make it even worse? Who knows!

[From [url=https://bloody-moonlight.itch.io/thanks-for-dinner]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
NN镇里，人们开始失踪……没人知道他们失踪在哪里。这个故事让你有机会影响事件的结果。你能阻止人们失踪还是会让事情变得更糟？谁知道呢！

[来自[url=https://bloody-moonlight.itch.io/thanks-for-dinner]Itch.io[/url]]
